# Third-party code

Runtime dependencies used by the objective evaluators:

- `imagebind/`: ImageBind inference code for AVAlign.
- `synchformer/`: Synchformer inference code for AVSync.
- `vbench_long/`: VBench and VBench-Long code required by SC and BC.

Model checkpoints are downloaded separately with
[`scripts/download_assets.sh`](../scripts/download_assets.sh). See
[`NOTICE`](../NOTICE) for upstream terms.
